posts.author: dantonmuse
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Animated weapons for use with Yanfly Animated Weapon plugin
Maker Format:
MV
Makers I Own:
Ace, MV
Art Style:
Same as the original MV animated weapons
Description:
I bought resources from gamedevmaker but for most of my weapons I cannot find similar weapon animations. I cannot make art, it’s just not in my skill set. I wanted to see if someone was able to do this for me. I need the animations in the same format as regular MV, they can be in a sheet or individual. I need Axes, Hammers, Whips, rifles, claws. I do not want replica assets of the resources shown below (I believe that is not allowed for these resources) however I’d like weapons with this kind of creativity (I have found so many swords it feels like the only weapon with love)
If you can point me in another direction to find resources (For free or for purchase) please point me to it, I am exhausted of searching through a search engine.
Reference Images:
https://www.gamedevmarket.net/asset/admurins-items-mega-pack-a
<— this is one pack where those weapons are. the image with the word “Armory” has ideas for the kind of artistic creativity used to make the weapons
https://www.gamedevmarket.net/asset/50-pixel-icons-of-the-gloves
<— this is for the claws
Thank you for your time!
